name: stockP

input.prompt: Straight-on top view of a single blank broadsheet newspaper page printed on BLACK newsprint stock, filling the entire frame edge to edge. Nothing is printed on it: no letters, no words, no numbers, no symbols, no pictures, no logos, no masthead text. Only the paper itself: fine paper fibres, a soft horizontal fold crease about one third from the top and a faint vertical crease down the middle, slightly worn soft corners, very faint dark grey ink offset smudges. Lit like the reference image: one warm gold key light from the top left that falls off into deep black toward the bottom and the edges, a thin green rim light along the right edge and a thin red rim light along the left edge. Painted comic illustration with ink texture, heavy blacks, matte, no glare. The page must stay almost black so cream text can be printed on it later.

refs: img/ref-chip.jpg (copy of media/bet-chip-h2.jpg; removed after the run)
